title: Llama with sparkly eyes
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#fff6c8'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffd24a'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- neck -->
  <rect x='43' y='52' width='14' height='30' rx='6' fill='#f2e3c6'/>
  <rect x='43' y='52' width='14' height='6' rx='3' fill='#d8c19a'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='80' rx='24' ry='14' fill='#f7ecd4'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='86' rx='22' ry='7' fill='#e3d0ab'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='34' y='86' width='7' height='11' rx='3' fill='#e3d0ab'/>
  <rect x='59' y='86' width='7' height='11' rx='3' fill='#e3d0ab'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <circle cx='73' cy='76' r='5' fill='#f7ecd4'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='42' rx='17' ry='15' fill='#f7ecd4'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx='37' cy='27' rx='4' ry='8' transform='rotate(-18 37 27)' fill='#f2e3c6'/>
  <ellipse cx='63' cy='27' rx='4' ry='8' transform='rotate(18 63 27)' fill='#f2e3c6'/>
  <!-- snout -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='49' rx='9' ry='7' fill='#efdcc0'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='45' rx='2.5' ry='1.6' fill='#c08a5e'/>
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d='M45 50 Q50 53 55 50' stroke='#c08a5e' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- sparkly eyes -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='39' r='4.2' fill='#fffef0'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='39' r='4.2' fill='#fffef0'/>
  <circle cx='43' cy='39' r='2.4' fill='#4a3a2a'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='39' r='2.4' fill='#4a3a2a'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='38' r='1.3' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='38' r='1.3' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='40.5' r='0.7' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='40.5' r='0.7' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- star sparkles -->
  <path d='M36 30 l1 2.6 2.7 0.3 -2 1.8 0.6 2.7 -2.3 -1.4 -2.3 1.4 0.6 -2.7 -2 -1.8 2.7 -0.3z' fill='url(#glow)'/>
  <path d='M64 32 l0.9 2.3 2.4 0.3 -1.8 1.6 0.5 2.4 -2 -1.2 -2 1.2 0.5 -2.4 -1.8 -1.6 2.4 -0.3z' fill='url(#glow)'/>
  <circle cx='51' cy='33' r='0.9' fill='#fff6c8'/>
</svg>
